state.circumstances: You're the general manager of KOMA, Tao Group Hospitality's Japanese restaurant at The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, open since July 2019. Tao Group runs it with Marina Bay Sands; you run the sushi bar, the robata, the lounge and 230 seats, and report to Tao Group's Singapore leadership. Prices on the menu are before the 10% service charge and 9% GST, as Singapore restaurants print them.

features.name: The bell and the bridge

features.name: The mezzanine private dining room
features.pitch: A private room above the main floor for corporate dinners and celebrations.

setting.name: The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore
setting.desc: The basement level of the mall under the three towers of Marina Bay Sands. Bankers from Marina Bay Financial Centre at lunch, hotel and casino guests, conference delegates from the convention centre, birthday groups and tourists who came for the torii gate on Instagram.

ev.text: Formula 1 race week: the circuit runs past the door, and every table is booked from Thursday to Sunday.
Chinese New Year: lo hei at every corporate table and the mezzanine room booked every night for two weeks.
A big medical conference at the Sands Expo filled the lunch sets for a week.
A new Japanese omakase counter opened in the same mall, with a well-known chef from Tokyo.

mods.label: Tao Group Hospitality brand, systems and marketing

world.notes: KOMA is a Japanese restaurant and sushi bar by Tao Group Hospitality, created with Marina Bay Sands; it opened on 26 July 2019 at The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands (#B1-67, 10 Bayfront Avenue) with 230 seats, designed by Rockwell Group. Guests enter through a 20-metre passage of orange arches recalling the Fushimi Inari Shrine, into a lounge; the main room has soaring ceilings, a 2.5-metre bell above a traditional footbridge, an oversized sushi bar and a private dining room on the mezzanine. Hours: lunch daily 11.30am-3pm; dinner 5pm-11pm Sunday to Thursday and to midnight on Fridays, Saturdays and the eves of public holidays; the bar and lounge from 11.30am. The dishes, drinks, sets, trophy sakes and their prices are from KOMA's published menus (September 2026), converted from Singapore dollars at S$1.2797 to the US dollar; menu prices are before the 10% service charge and 9% GST. The Signature Lunch Set is S$58 for two courses and S$68 for three, Monday to Friday; the KOMA Tasting Menu is S$380 at lunch and dinner; the Sunday Sushi Omakase is S$158 with two hours of free-flow sake, soju and beer. Singapore's food-services Progressive Wage Model entry wage is S$2,220 a month from 1 July 2026. Sales, rent, floor area, the Tao Group fee, staff names and local events are estimates or invented.

Singapore.name: Singapore

alcohol.note: Restaurants serve alcohol under a liquor licence from the Singapore Police Force; public drinking is banned from 10.30pm to 7am, but licensed premises may serve within their hours.

inspections.system: The Singapore Food Agency licenses food establishments and inspects them.

Singapore.mealTimes: Lunch from about noon to 2pm, with office crowds on weekdays; dinner from about 7pm, and later on Fridays, Saturdays and the eves of public holidays.
Singapore.customs: Menus print prices before a 10% service charge and 9% GST (the 'plus-plus'), and tipping beyond the service charge is rare. Guests are a mix of residents, business travellers and tourists from the Marina Bay Sands hotel and casino; cards and mobile payments are expected, and cash is rare.
Singapore.labour: Employers pay CPF of 17% on the wages of Singapore citizens and permanent residents aged 55 and under. Food-service workers who are citizens or PRs are covered by the Progressive Wage Model, which sets an entry wage of S$2,220 a month from July 2026, rising to S$2,500 by July 2028. Foreign staff need Work Permits or S Passes under quotas and levies.

holidays.name: Chinese New Year
holidays.note: Reunion dinners and corporate lo hei; the city's busiest weeks for restaurants, in January or February.

holidays.name: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix
holidays.note: The night race runs round Marina Bay; race week fills every table near the circuit.

holidays.name: Christmas and year end
holidays.note: Corporate dinners and New Year's Eve at full price.
